title: Carlson visits quarries exposing the black mat layer

tellings.quote: the black matte layer, which I've visited about three or four um quaries now where you can see the black matte layer exposed.

plain: A researcher of ancient catastrophes, Randall Carlson, says he has visited three or four quarries where you can see the "black mat" exposed, a dark layer of soil that some link to the start of the Younger Dryas, a sudden cold spell near the end of the last ice age. He tells it as seeing for himself the physical trace of what he thinks was a cosmic disaster.
